<module id="alu">
    <description>A 32-bit Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU).</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">First input operand.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">Second input operand.</input>
        <input id="aluc" width_description="[5:0]">Control signal for ALU operation.</input>
        <output id="r" width_description="[31:0]">Result of ALU operation.</output>
        <output id="zero">Zero flag.</output>
        <output id="carry">Carry flag.</output>
        <output id="negative">Negative flag.</output>
        <output id="overflow">Overflow flag.</output>
        <output id="flag">Flag for comparison operations.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="ADD">6'b100000</parameter>
        <parameter id="ADDU">6'b100001</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUB">6'b100010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUBU">6'b100011</parameter>
        <parameter id="AND">6'b100100</parameter>
        <parameter id="OR">6'b100101</parameter>
        <parameter id="XOR">6'b100110</parameter>
        <parameter id="NOR">6'b100111</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLT">6'b101010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLTU">6'b101011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLL">6'b000000</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRL">6'b000010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRA">6'b000011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLLV">6'b000100</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRLV">6'b000110</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRAV">6'b000111</parameter>
        <parameter id="LUI">6'b001111</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <register id="res" width="33">
            <reset_value>32'h0</reset_value>
            <next_value>
                <conditional>
                    <if condition="aluc == SLL || aluc == SRL || aluc == SRA || aluc == SLLV || aluc == SRLV || aluc == SRAV">
                        <value>res >> a[4:0]</value>
                    </if>
                    <else>
                        <value>res[31:0]</value>
                    </else>
                </conditional>
            </next_value>
        </register>
        <assign id="r" value="res[31:0]" />
        
        <assign id="flag" value="(aluc == SLT || aluc == SLTU)? res[32]: 1'bz" />
        <assign id="zero" value="(res[31:0]==32'd0) ? 1 : 0" />
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>
        reg [32:0] res;
        wire signed [31:0] a_signed = $signed(a);
        wire signed [31:0] b_signed = $signed(b);
        always@(*) begin
            casex(aluc)
                ADD: res <= a + b;
                ADDU: res <= a + b;
                SUB: res <= a_signed - b_signed;
                SUBU: res <= a - b;
                AND: res <= a & b;
                OR: res <= a | b;
                XOR: res <= a ^ b;
                NOR: res <= ~(a | b);
                SLT: res <= {32{1'b0}};
                SLTU: res <= {32{1'b0}};
                SLL: res <= b << a[4:0];
                SRL: res <= b >> a[4:0];
                SRA: res <= b_signed >>> a[4:0];
                SLLV: res <= b << a[4:0];
                SRLV: res <= b >> a[4:0];
                SRAV: res <= b_signed >>> a[4:0];
                LUI: res <= {a[15:0], 16'b0};
                default: res <= 33'bZ;
            endcase
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
